This Time Table Will be Treated as Final Time Table, If there is no any issue related paper overlaping, missing or incorrect Course Name & Course Code.
03. The candidates are requested to be present at their respective place of examination TWENTY MINUTES before the time appointed for seating of the First paper and FIFTEEN MINUTES before the time of seating of each 
subsequent paper. They are forbidden to take any book or paper into the Examination Hall. 
INSTRUCTION:  All the students and faculty members must communicate to exam cell on or before 19th November 2024 for any issues related to Course Name & Course Code wrong or missing, paper overlaping.
01. MSE shall be based on the 50% weightage of syllabus for 30 marks with duaration 90 minutes (01hrs 30min.) for F. Y. B. Tech. / M. Tech.
02. The Identity Card and Examination Hall Ticket is Compulsory at the time of Examination. Identity Card must be duly sign by student & concern head of the department.

09.  The Examination Programme is subject to change. If there is any change in the programme of the examination, it will be communicated in time through KIT Website, Exam Cell Notice Board, Students or 
WhatsApp goups; however the College is not responsible for any loss or inconvenience caused to the candidate. 
10. The seating arrangement is made date-wise & course -wise; therefore candidates are requested to see their seating arrangement before the date of Examination. The same will be displayed at Examination Cell Notice Board/ 
display board at college entrance.
11. The Cellular Phone, Digital Watches, Digital Gadget Programmable Calculator, Digital Diary or any means are not allowed in the examination hall.
04.  The exchange or loan of drawing instruments or other material used in the examination is not permitted while the examination is in progress. Candidates must bring their own instruments.
05. The students are not permitted to leave the examination hall, while the examination is in progress. 
06. The students are not permitted to discuss/talk with other students in examination hall, whlile the examination is in progesss.
07. Use of only Blue Ink (except diagrame) is permitted.  No suppliment will be provided at the time of examination.
08.  The candidates are allowed to use the scientific calculators for numerical calculations at their own cost. College will not supply such calculators.
